reason: Halal collagen and the meals for families in need is exactly what I'd want to back, and my joints could use it with the gym. But I've never heard of RizqPure, it doesn't say who certifies it or that it's Muslim-owned, and with a kid and £25k I'm not putting £18 on a brand I can't check.
objection: I have never heard of this brand. 'Halal-certified' means nothing to me until I know which body certified it, and 320 reviews on their own site could be anyone.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the named halal certifier and that it's actually Muslim-owned, ideally vouched for by someone I follow or at the mosque, or a smaller trial size so I'm not risking the full £18.
